ui.title: Training Quiz
ui.h1: How should training work on the hub?
ui.p: Ideas from real athletes and training apps. Rate each one 1 to 10. 10 = love it! Tap 🤔 Other to say how you'd do it.
ui.aboutTitle: What other young athletes say works
ui.other: Instead of "%s", how would you do it? Say it or type it.

about: Kids who stick with training apps brag about their totals: "76,000 shots and counting." Seeing the number grow is proof you're getting better.
The most-copied workout online is written in levels: 5 makes from each wing, then 15 free throws MADE. You pass a level when you hit the makes, not when time runs out.
The top complaint about camera apps: "I did 10 and it gave me 4." Kids would rather tap their own count.
The big training apps are basketball and soccer only. Volleyball players say they can't find one.
Rate each card 1 to 10 (10 = love it, 1 = no way), or tap 🤔 Other and say what you'd do instead. Got an idea? Tap 🎤.

ideas.title: Season counter
ideas.desc: Your page shows your total makes, reps and workouts this season, and the number keeps climbing.

ideas.title: Workouts as levels
ideas.desc: Each workout has levels. Hit the makes (like 15 free throws made) to unlock the next level.

ideas.title: Beat your best
ideas.desc: When you beat your personal best, it lights up on the screen. You only race yourself.

ideas.title: Big +1 / +5 buttons
ideas.desc: During a workout, tap big buttons to count your makes. No camera guessing wrong.

ideas.title: Week ring
ideas.desc: Like Apple Watch rings: 3 workouts a week fills your ring.

ideas.title: Drill of the week
ideas.desc: A new featured drill every week, so training never gets repetitive.

ideas.title: Challenge a friend
ideas.desc: Opt in to a challenge with a friend who comes over. Never brother vs. sister.

ideas.title: After-game check-in
ideas.desc: After a game, one tap: what went better? (Nerves, serve, defense…) Growth isn't only numbers.

ideas.title: Form clip
ideas.desc: Record 5 seconds of your shot or serve and see it next to a model, side by side.

ideas.title: A real volleyball plan
ideas.desc: Serving, passing and jump-training levels just for you, the same way basketball works.

ideas.title: Football + baseball plans too
ideas.desc: Speed, agility and throwing levels for football and baseball, not just basketball.

ideas.title: Parent spot-check
ideas.desc: Mom or Dad can see each workout's counts and give a 👍. No approval needed for every one.
